entities.title: An invitation, accepted, played to mate
entities.summary: Invite by email, find it after signing in, accept once, play to mate, chat after, and see it in both histories and contacts.
criteria: An invitation to a cleaned address is stored and linked; not to oneself or a non-address
Only the addressee can accept, once; only the players see the game
Four moves end the game by checkmate, broadcast four times; a later action is refused but chat is kept
Both players have each other as contacts with the record; an invitation alone makes no contact

checks.symbol: a challenge by email, accepted, played to mate, in both players' history and contacts
declining and cancelling invitations; removing a contact

entities.title: What an action does to a game
entities.summary: Turn order, stale plies, mate, draw offers and answers, resignation and chat.
criteria: Out of turn, a stale ply or an illegal move is refused
Mate ends the game with move and end entries
Offering back accepts; a move withdraws an offer; only the other side accepts or declines
Chat is cleaned, logged with its side, allowed after the game and never empty

checks.symbol: actions: turn order, stale moves, mate ends the game
actions: draw offers, accepting, declining, and a move answering one
chat: cleaned, logged with its side, allowed after the game too, never empty

entities.details: The suites drive RoomCore directly; GameRoom's WebSockets, hibernation and the save conflict (409 "The board changed") are not tested.

entities.title: Sign-in
entities.summary: Signed out, only /me answers; sign-in goes to the host's; the login service is asked on every request; a person plays as the address Gambit knows.
criteria: Signed out, /me says so and the rest is 401; auth/dev is 404 without DEV_LOGIN
Return paths outside the game become its front page
login and the old callbacks redirect to /auth/sign-in; sign-out clears site_session and refuses another origin
A person known by an older address plays as it; a session the login service drops signs them out at once
A Bearer token works like the cookie

checks.symbol: signed out: /me says so; everything else needs sign-in; dev sign-in only when enabled
sign-in goes to icelander.net's one sign-in; signing out is the site's
through the login service: checked on every request, and a person plays as the address Gambit knows
profile pictures only from Google or GitHub; a Bearer token works like the cookie

entities.title: Cross-site writes and games against the computer
entities.summary: A POST from another origin is refused; a game against the computer is stored only when legal and over.
criteria: A POST with another Origin is 403
Unfinished or illegal computer games are 422
A resigned game is stored with start, move, resign and end, keeping the move times
The computer is named from LEVELS

checks.symbol: cross-site and non-JSON writes are refused
games against the computer: saved only when finished and legal
